remarks: On a sunlit corner in Lake Lindero sits a home that feels instantly welcoming--fresh, bright, and thoughtfully updated for the way people live today. Every space has been refreshed with care, from the new crisp white Shaker kitchen to the soft new carpet underfoot. With mountain views in the heart of Lake Lindero, this 5 bedroom, 3 bath residence blends modern comfort with timeless style, offering generous living spaces and a floorplan designed for everyday ease. The newly remodeled kitchen is a standout, featuring new white Shaker cabinets, Quartz countertops, new cooktop, oven, sink, dishwasher, and faucet with a breakfast bar and luxury vinyl plank flooring.
